name: What are the benefits of upgrading my shower or tub?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading my shower or tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading your shower or tub can enhance your bathroom's aesthetic, improve functionality, and increase your home's value. Modern fixtures often offer better water efficiency, and new designs can create a more accessible or luxurious bathing experience. It also provides an opportunity to address any existing issues like leaks or outdated plumbing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Upgrading can improve aesthetics, functionality, home value, and address plumbing issues.
